findings.evidence: Polynomial.lean:71-79 define/restate `signCount` only via `fiberCount (fun x : Z => ..)`; grep `signCount_eq_card` in code/TauCeti: no matches. roadmap/TauCetiRoadmap/RealAlgebraicGeometry/Suggested.lean:62 states the count as `(p.roots.toFinset.filter fun x => ∀ i, SignType.sign ((q i).eval x) = σ i).card`. Mathlib has no one-step bridge: `Finset.card_subtype` (Data/Finset/Card.lean:275) is about `s.subtype p`, and `Finset.filter_attach` (Data/Finset/Image.lean:187) yields a `map` of an `attach`.
findings.fix: Add `theorem signCount_eq_card_filter (Z : Finset R) (Q : J → R[X]) (σ : J → SignType) : signCount Z Q σ = (Z.filter fun x => ∀ j, sign ((Q j).eval x) = σ j).card` (classical), and derive `signCount_pos` from it.
findings.issue: `signCount` is defined via the subtype `x : Z` and its only restatement (`signCount_eq_fiberCount`, then `fiberCount_eq_card_filter`) yields `(univ.filter fun x : ↥Z => (fun j => sign ..) = σ).card`. The roadmap's Layer 3 count `cσ` and its `sign_matrix` target state the count as `(p.roots.toFinset.filter fun x => ∀ i, sign ((q i).eval x) = σ i).card`; the file's own `signCount_pos` and `signSum_eq_card_sub_card` already use the ambient `Z.filter` form. Consumers must convert subtype-filter cardinality to ambient-filter cardinality (`univ_eq_attach`, `filter_attach`, `card_map`, `card_attach`, `funext_iff`) themselves.

findings.fix: Add `@[simp] signSum_zero`, `@[simp] signSum_one`, `@[simp] tarskiQuery_zero_right`, and `@[simp] tarskiQuery_one` in Polynomial.lean / Roots.lean.
findings.issue: Only the roots-side zero convention `tarskiQuery_zero_left` is recorded. The query-side nullary cases are absent: `signSum Z 0 = 0`, `signSum Z 1 = Z.card`, and hence `tarskiQuery p 0 = 0`, `tarskiQuery p 1 = p.roots.toFinset.card`. The roadmap explicitly requires handling zero query values, and `TaQ(1,p)` (distinct root count) is the base row of the BKR system; reaching it via `tarskiQuery_prod_pow` with `J = Unit` and `pow_zero` is an unfolding workaround.

summary: Prior findings are addressed (fiberCount restatement present, signSum_eq_sum no longer simp, both inverse identities simp). Two characteristic lemmas are still missing: an ambient-Finset cardinality form for signCount matching the roadmap's count, and the zero/one query cases for signSum and tarskiQuery.
